decisions: Read canonical ordinals2,18,27,29. Result order is T2DM then NGT; values bound separately rather than interchangeable numbers.
Use analyzed sample41 from abstract, not recruited44 from body ordinal12. NGT comparator n14.
MRI measures total pancreas volume, not head/lesion size or a CT reference interval.
Both groups use mean plus/minus SEM; do not relabel SEM as SD or infer an individual range.
NGT comparator matched to diabetes group by age, weight and sex. T2DM group well controlled on metformin only.

Interpretation limits are application policy based on selected population and modality, not verbatim author conclusions. Statistical glossary is controlled mathematical explanation, not an extra medical finding.
No expert/human/independent acceptance is claimed; registry admission preserves this review rather than proving its correctness.
